name: testimonial-slider
title: Testimonial Slider
blurb: Testimonial carousel with rotating images and cross-fading quotes.
description: Auto-rotating testimonial carousel with image carousel (60deg rotate + fade effect) and quote text that fades and translates. Includes previous/next navigation buttons (with aria-labels), pauses auto-rotation on manual interaction, then…
use_when: Social proof sections where testimonials are presented as rotating carousel with both visual (images) and textual…
avoid_when: Static testimonial display — auto-rotation runs continuously regardless of user interaction depth.
a11y: Navigation buttons have aria-labels. Images have alt text. Supports light/dark mode. Pauses on manual click then restarts, improving accessibility for screen readers.
